Am scris acest lucru într-un limbaj simplu, deoarece credem că nu ar trebui să aveți nevoie de o diplomă în drept pentru a înțelege cum sunt gestionate datele dvs.

1. Cine suntem

  • entitate juridică: FKG Trading LLC
  • Site web: dresslikemommy.com
  • Adresa: 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA
  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Telefon: (786) 309-6006

FKG Trading LLC este operatorul de date pentru toate informațiile personale colectate prin intermediul acestui site web.

2. Informații pe care le colectăm

Informații pe care le furnizați direct

Când faceți cumpărături cu noi, vă creați un cont sau ne contactați, puteți furniza:

  • Informații de contact — nume, adresă de e-mail, număr de telefon
  • Adrese de expediere și facturare
  • Informații de plată — detalii card de credit/debit (procesate în siguranță de Shopify Payments; nu vedem sau stocăm niciodată numărul complet al cardului)
  • Aacreditările contului — e-mail și parolă dacă creați un cont
  • Comunicații — mesaje pe care ni le trimiteți prin e-mail, formulare de contact sau rețele sociale
  • Detalii comandă — produse achiziționate, dimensiuni, cantități

Informații colectate automat

Când vizitați site-ul nostru, anumite informații sunt colectate automat:

  • Informații despre dispozitiv și browser — tip de browser, sistem de operare, rezoluție ecran, tip de dispozitiv
  • IP adresa și locația aproximativă (la nivel de oraș/regiune)
  • Activitate de navigare — pagini vizitate, produse vizualizate, timpul petrecut pe pagini, site-ul de referință
  • Cookie-uri și tehnologii similare (vezi secțiunea 5)

Informații de la terți

Putem primi informații limitate de la:

  • Shopify — platforma noastră de comerț electronic
  • Procesoare de plăți — confirmarea tranzacției și prevenirea fraudei
  • Plateforme de marketing — dacă interacționați cu anunțurile noastre

3. Cum folosim informațiile dvs.

  • Procesează și onorează-ți comenzile
  • Trimiteți confirmări de comandă, actualizări de expediere și chitanțe
  • Răspundeți la întrebările și solicitările dvs. de asistență
  • IÎmbunătățiți site-ul nostru web, produsele și experiența de cumpărături
  • Trimiteți e-mailuri de marketing (numai cu acordul dvs.)
  • Detectați și preveniți frauda
  • Respectarea obligațiilor legale
  • Personalizați-vă experiența de cumpărături

Nu vom vinde niciodată informațiile dumneavoastră personale către terți.

4. Servicii terță parte

  • Shopify — alimentează magazinul nostru online și procesează comenzi
  • Shopify Payments (Stripe) — procesarea plăților conformă cu PCI-DSS
  • Marketing prin e-mail — livrare buletin informativ; dezabonați-vă oricând
  • Transportatori — livrați comanda și asigurați urmărirea
  • Google Analytics — date agregate de utilizare a site-ului

Nu împărtășim informațiile dvs. cu terțe părți în propriile lor scopuri de marketing.

5. Cookie-uri și urmărire

Folosim cookie-uri pentru a vă menține coșul activ, pentru a reține preferințele, pentru a înțelege traficul și pentru a sprijini marketingul (cu consimțământ). Controlați cookie-urile prin setările browserului dumneavoastră.

6. Confidențialitatea copiilor

Dress Like Mommy vinde îmbrăcăminte pentru copii, dar site-ul nostru web nu este destinat copiilor. Toate achizițiile trebuie făcute de un adult (18+). Nu colectăm cu bună știință informații de la nimeni sub 16 (sau 13 în SUA).

7. Păstrarea datelor

  • Înregistrări comenzi — 7 ani pentru impozit/contabilitate
  • Ainformații cont — în timp ce este activ; șters la cerere
  • Consimțământ pentru marketing — până când vă dezabonați
  • Analitice — anonimizat în 26 luni
  • Suport comunicații — până la 3 ani după rezoluție

8. Drepturile tale

Toți clienții pot accesa, corecta, se pot dezabona de la marketing și pot solicita ștergerea datelor lor.

GDPR (SEE/Regatul Unit/Elveția): Portabilitatea datelor, restricționarea prelucrării sau opoziția față de aceasta, retragerea consimțământului și depunerea de plângeri.

CCPA (California): Aflați ce colectăm, ștergem datele, renunțați la vânzări. Nu vă vindem datele.

Contact: info@dresslikemommy.com. Răspuns în 30 zile.

9. Securitatea datelor

SSL/TLS criptare, PCI-DSS procesare plăți, controale acces. Nicio metodă nu este sigură 100%.

10. Transferuri internaționale

Serverele Shopify pot fi situate în afara țării dumneavoastră. Transferurile SEE/Regatul Unit/Elveția utilizează Clauzele contractuale standard.

11. Modificări

Actualizăm data „Ultima actualizare” pentru modificări semnificative.

12. Contactați-ne

  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Telefon: (786) 309-6006
  • Adresă poștală: FKG Trading LLC, 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

Dress Like Mommy is operated by FKG Trading LLC, a Florida limited liability company. Your privacy matters to us — this policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

We’ve written this in plain language because we believe you shouldn’t need a law degree to understand how your data is handled.

1. Who We Are

  • Legal Entity: FKG Trading LLC
  • Website: dresslikemommy.com
  • Address: 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA
  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006

FKG Trading LLC is the data controller for all personal information collected through this website.

2. Information We Collect

Information You Provide Directly

When you shop with us, create an account, or get in touch, you may provide:

  • Contact information — name, email address, phone number
  • Shipping and billing addresses
  • Payment information — credit/debit card details (processed securely by Shopify Payments; we never see or store your full card number)
  • Account credentials — email and password if you create an account
  • Communications — messages you send us via email, contact forms, or social media
  • Order details — products purchased, sizes, quantities

Information Collected Automatically

When you visit our site, certain information is collected automatically:

  • Device and browser information — browser type, operating system, screen resolution, device type
  • IP address and approximate location (city/region level)
  • Browsing activity — pages visited, products viewed, time spent on pages, referring website
  • Cookies and similar technologies (see Section 5)

Information from Third Parties

We may receive limited information from:

  • Shopify — our e-commerce platform
  • Payment processors — transaction confirmation and fraud prevention
  • Marketing platforms — if you interact with our ads

3. How We Use Your Information

  • Process and fulfill your orders
  • Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and receipts
  • Respond to your questions and support requests
  • Improve our website, products, and shopping experience
  • Send marketing emails (only with your consent)
  • Detect and prevent fraud
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Personalize your shopping experience

We will never sell your personal information to third parties.

4. Third-Party Services

  • Shopify — powers our online store and processes orders
  • Shopify Payments (Stripe) — PCI-DSS compliant payment processing
  • Email marketing — newsletter delivery; unsubscribe anytime
  • Shipping carriers — deliver your order and provide tracking
  • Google Analytics — aggregated site usage data

We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

5. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to keep your cart active, remember preferences, understand traffic, and support marketing (with consent). Control cookies via your browser settings.

6. Children’s Privacy

Dress Like Mommy sells children’s clothing, but our website is not directed at children. All purchases must be made by an adult (18+). We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16 (or 13 in the US).

7. Data Retention

  • Order records — 7 years for tax/accounting
  • Account info — while active; deleted on request
  • Marketing consent — until you unsubscribe
  • Analytics — anonymized within 26 months
  • Support comms — up to 3 years after resolution

8. Your Rights

All customers can access, correct, unsubscribe from marketing, and request deletion of their data.

GDPR (EEA/UK/Switzerland): Data portability, restrict/object to processing, withdraw consent, lodge complaints.

CCPA (California): Know what we collect, delete data, opt out of sales. We do not sell your data.

Contact: info@dresslikemommy.com. Response within 30 days.

9. Data Security

SSL/TLS encryption, PCI-DSS payment processing, access controls. No method is 100% secure.

10. International Transfers

Shopify servers may be outside your country. EEA/UK/Swiss transfers use Standard Contractual Clauses.

11. Changes

We update the “Last Updated” date for significant changes.

12. Contact Us

  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006
  • Mail: FKG Trading LLC, 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA

Privacy Policy by FKG Trading LLC, operator of Dress Like Mommy.

Kontakt: info@dresslikemommy.com. Svar inom 30 dagar.

SSL/TLS kryptering, PCI-DSS betalningshantering, åtkomstkontroller. Ingen metod är 100% säker.

10. Internationella överföringar

Shopify-servrar kan vara utanför ditt land. EES/UK/Schweiziska överföringar använder standardavtalsklausuler.

Terms of Service

Last Updated: January 28, 2026

Welcome to Dress Like Mommy (dresslikemommy.com), operated by FKG Trading LLC, a Florida limited liability company. By accessing our website or placing an order, you agree to these Terms of Service.

1. About These Terms

These Terms govern your use of the Dress Like Mommy website and all related services. “We,” “us,” or “our” means FKG Trading LLC. “You” or “your” means the person visiting or purchasing from our site. We may update these Terms; continued use constitutes acceptance.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years of age, have legal capacity to enter a binding agreement, and provide accurate information. While we sell children’s clothing, all purchases must be made by an adult.

3. Products and Pricing

  • Product images are as accurate as possible; slight color variations may occur due to screen settings
  • Prices display in the currency selected or shown at checkout unless otherwise noted.
  • We reserve the right to update prices at any time; changes don’t affect existing orders
  • We may limit order quantities at our discretion

4. Orders and Payment

  • Placing an order is an offer to purchase; we may accept or decline at our discretion
  • You’ll receive an order confirmation email upon acceptance
  • We accept major credit cards, debit cards, and other payment methods displayed at checkout
  • Payment is processed securely through Shopify Payments (powered by Stripe)
  • All prices include applicable discounts; taxes and shipping are calculated at checkout

5. Shipping and Delivery

  • Dress Like Mommy is an online store. Shipping is available to countries and regions where checkout shows an available shipping method for the address entered.
  • Processing time is typically 1-3 business days after payment confirmation.
  • Available shipping methods, rates, delivery estimates, taxes, and duties information are shown at checkout before payment where available.
  • Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available.
  • Express shipping may be available for some destinations where shown at checkout.
  • Tracking information is provided by email once the order ships.
  • We are not responsible for delays caused by customs, weather, holidays, carrier issues, or local delivery conditions.

For full shipping details, see our Shipping Information page.

6. Returns and Refunds

  • Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery
  • Items must be unworn, unwashed, with original tags attached
  • Return shipping costs are the customer’s responsibility unless we made an error
  • Refunds processed to original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Sale items and personalized items are final sale

For full return details, see our Return Policy.

7. Intellectual Property

All content on this website — including text, images, logos, graphics, and product photos — is owned by or licensed to FKG Trading LLC and protected by copyright and trademark laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or use our content without written permission.

8. User Conduct

You agree not to: use the site for unlawful purposes, interfere with site functionality, attempt unauthorized access, submit false information, use automated tools to scrape content, or infringe on others’ rights.

9. Disclaimer of Warranties

Our website and products are provided “as is” without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that our site will be uninterrupted or error-free. Product quality is based on manufacturer specifications and may have minor variations.

10. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, FKG Trading LLC’s total liability is limited to the amount you paid for the specific product or service at issue. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages.

11. Indemnification

You agree to indemnify and hold harmless FKG Trading LLC from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your use of our website, violation of these Terms, or infringement of any third-party rights.

12. Privacy

Your use of our site is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

13. Third-Party Links

Our site may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their content, privacy practices, or terms. Use them at your own risk.

14. Force Majeure

We are not liable for delays or failure to perform due to circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including natural disasters, pandemics, supply chain disruptions, government actions, or technical failures.

15. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Collier County, Florida.

16. Severability

If any provision of these Terms is found invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in full effect.

17. Entire Agreement

These Terms, together with our Privacy Policy and Return Policy, constitute the entire agreement between you and FKG Trading LLC regarding your use of our website.

18. Contact Us

  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006
  • Mail: FKG Trading LLC, 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA

  • Vi kan begränsa orderkvantiteterna efter eget gottfinnande

  • Att lägga en beställning är ett köperbjudande; vi kan acceptera eller avslå efter eget gottfinnande
  • Du kommer att få en orderbekräftelse via e-post vid godkännande
  • Vi accepterar vanliga kreditkort, betalkort och andra betalningsmetoder som visas i kassan
  • Betalning behandlas säkert genom Shopify Payments (driven av Stripe)
  • Alla priser inkluderar tillämpliga rabatter; skatter och frakt beräknas i kassan

5. Frakt och leverans

  • Dress Like Mommy är en webbutik. Frakt är tillgänglig till länder och regioner där kassan visar en tillgänglig leveransmetod för den angivna adressen.
  • Behandlingstiden är vanligtvis 1-3 arbetsdagar efter betalningsbekräftelse.
  • Tillgängliga fraktmetoder, priser, leveransuppskattningar, skatter och tullinformation visas i kassan före betalning där tillgängligt.
  • Standardfrakt ingår i produktpriserna för länder och regioner där en standardmetod är tillgänglig.
  • Expressfrakt kan vara tillgänglig för vissa destinationer som visas i kassan.
  • Spårningsinformation tillhandahålls via e-post när beställningen skickas.
  • Vi är inte ansvariga för förseningar orsakade av tull, väder, helgdagar, transportproblem eller lokala leveransvillkor.

För fullständig fraktinformation, se vår fraktinformation sida.

6. Returer och återbetalningar

  • Returer accepteras inom 30 dagar från leverans
  • Varorna måste vara oanvända, otvättade, med originaletiketter bifogade
  • Returfraktkostnader är kundens ansvar om vi inte har gjort ett fel
  • Återbetalningar behandlas till den ursprungliga betalningsmetoden inom 5–10 arbetsdagar
  • Reavaror och personligt anpassade varor kan inte returneras

För fullständig returinformation, se vår Returpolicy.

Allt innehåll på denna webbplats – inklusive text, bilder, logotyper, grafik och produktfoton – ägs av eller licensieras till FKG Trading LLC och skyddas av upphovsrätts- och varumärkeslagar. Du får inte reproducera, distribuera eller använda vårt innehåll utan skriftligt tillstånd.

8. Användaruppförande

Du förbinder dig att inte använda webbplatsen för olagliga ändamål, störa dess funktion, försöka få obehörig åtkomst, lämna falska uppgifter, använda automatiserade verktyg för att samla in innehåll eller kränka andras rättigheter.

9. Garantifriskrivning

Vår webbplats och produkter tillhandahålls "i befintligt skick" utan garantier av något slag, uttryckliga eller underförstådda. Vi garanterar inte att vår sida kommer att vara oavbruten eller felfri. Produktkvaliteten är baserad på tillverkarens specifikationer och kan ha mindre variationer.

10. Ansvarsbegränsning

I den maximala utsträckning som lagen tillåter är FKG Trading LLC:s totala ansvar begränsat till det belopp du betalat för den specifika produkten eller tjänsten i fråga. Vi är inte ansvariga för indirekta, tillfälliga, speciella eller följdskador.

11. Skadesersättning

Du samtycker till att hålla FKG Trading LLC skadeslös från alla anspråk, skador eller utgifter som uppstår från din användning av vår webbplats, brott mot dessa villkor eller intrång i tredje parts rättigheter.

12. Sekretess

Din användning av vår webbplats styrs också av vår Sekretesspolicy, som förklarar hur vi samlar in, använder och skyddar din information.

13. Tredjepartslänkar

Vår webbplats kan innehålla länkar till tredje parts webbplatser. Vi är inte ansvariga för deras innehåll, sekretesspraxis eller villkor. Använd dem på egen risk.

14. Force Majeure

Vi är inte ansvariga för förseningar eller underlåtenhet att utföra på grund av omständigheter utanför vår rimliga kontroll, inklusive naturkatastrofer, pandemier, avbrott i leveranskedjan, statliga åtgärder eller tekniska fel.

15. Gällande lag

Dessa villkor styrs av lagarna i delstaten Florida. Eventuella tvister ska lösas i domstolarna i Collier County, Florida.

16. Avskiljbarhet

Om någon bestämmelse i dessa villkor befinns vara ogiltig eller omöjlig att verkställa, förblir de återstående bestämmelserna i full verkan.

17. Hela avtalet

Dessa villkor, tillsammans med vår integritetspolicy och returpolicy, utgör hela avtalet mellan dig och FKG Trading LLC angående din användning av vår webbplats.

18. Kontakta oss

  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Telefon: (786) 309-6006
  • Postadress: FKG Trading LLC, 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA

swedishRefundReplacement.source:
Returns & Exchanges

We want you and your family to love your matching outfits! If something isn't right, we're here to help.

Return Window

You have 30 days from the date of delivery to request a return or exchange.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and in original condition
  • In their original packaging with all tags attached
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, or signs of wear

Non-Returnable Items

  • Swimwear and intimates (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items returned after 30 days

How to Start a Return

  1. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and reason for return
  2. Our team will review your request and respond within 1 business day
  3. We'll provide return instructions and a return shipping address
  4. Ship the item(s) back in their original packaging

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • You'll receive an email confirming we received your item
  • If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days
  • Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 2–5 business days to appear on your statement

Exchanges

Want a different size or color? Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and we'll help you get the right item.

Damaged or Defective Items

Received a damaged or defective item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund — no need to return the damaged item.

Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received your refund within 10 business days of our confirmation email:

  1. Check your bank account or credit card statement
  2. Contact your credit card company — processing times vary
  3. Contact your bank — there may be additional processing time
  4. Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com and we'll investigate

Shipping Costs

  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, unless the item arrived damaged or defective
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable

Questions?

Email us at info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).

Last updated: January 2026
swedishRefundReplacement.beforeValue:
Returer & byten

Vi vill att du och din familj ska älska dina matchande outfits! Om något inte stämmer är vi här för att hjälpa dig.

Returfrist

Du har 30 dagar från leveransdatum för att begära retur eller byte.

Villkor för retur

För att vara berättigad till retur måste varorna vara:

  • Osliten, otvättad och i originalskick
  • I originalförpackningen med alla taggar bifogade
  • Fri från fläckar, djurhår, parfym eller tecken på slitage

Varor som inte kan returneras

  • Badkläder och underkläder (av hygieniska skäl)
  • Artiklar markerade som "Final Sale"
  • Presentkort
  • Artiklar returnerade efter 30 dagar

Så begär du en retur

  1. Emaila oss på info@dresslikemommy.com med ditt ordernummer och anledning till retur
  2. Vårt team kommer att granska din förfrågan och svara inom 1 arbetsdag
  3. Vi tillhandahåller returinstruktioner och en returadress
  4. Skicka tillbaka varan/varorna i originalförpackningen

Återbetalningar

När vi tar emot och inspekterar din retur:

  • Du kommer att få ett e-postmeddelande som bekräftar att vi tagit emot din vara
  • Om den godkänns kommer din återbetalning att behandlas till din ursprungliga betalningsmetod inom 5–10 arbetsdagar
  • Beroende på din bank kan det ta ytterligare 2–5 arbetsdagar innan det visas på ditt kontoutdrag

Byten

Vill du ha en annan storlek eller färg? Maila oss på info@dresslikemommy.com med ditt ordernummer så hjälper vi dig att få rätt artikel.

Skadade eller defekta varor

Fick du en skadad eller defekt vara? Kontakta oss inom 7 dagar efter leverans med bilder på problemet. Vi skickar en ersättning eller utfärdar en full återbetalning – du behöver inte returnera den skadade varan.

Försenade eller uteblivna återbetalningar

Om du inte har fått din återbetalning inom 10 arbetsdagar efter vår bekräftelse via e-post:

  1. Kontrollera ditt bankkonto eller kreditkortsutdrag
  2. Kontakta ditt kreditkortsföretag — handläggningstiderna varierar
  3. Kontakta din bank — det kan finnas ytterligare handläggningstid
  4. Emaila oss på info@dresslikemommy.com så kommer vi att undersöka

Fraktkostnader

  • Returfraktkostnader är kundens ansvar, såvida inte varan anlände skadad eller defekt
  • Originala fraktkostnader återbetalas inte

Frågor?

Mejla oss på info@dresslikemommy.com eller ring (786) 309-6006 (mån–fre, 9 AM – 5 PM EST).
